context: A police officer briefs a teen reporter on a public case
purpose: Teach: 暴露/罰金/原爆/仮面/陸軍/煙草/交際/県立

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ご苦労さま。今日は県立図書館で起きた事件について、報道資料を渡しておくよ。
lines.en: Good work. Today I'll hand you press materials about the incident at the prefectural library.
lines.style: Formal officer tone, calm and businesslike with junior.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます!容疑者は本当に仮面を被って侵入したんですか?
lines.en: Thank you! Did the suspect really wear a mask when breaking in?
lines.style: Eager teen reporter, polite but visibly excited.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: そうだ。防犯カメラに映っていた。容疑者は元陸軍の関係者だという情報もある。
lines.en: That's right. He was on the security camera. There's info he's a former army contact.
lines.style: Measured delivery, releasing facts piece by piece.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 陸軍?それって戦時中の資料を狙ったってことですか?原爆関連の文書とか…
lines.en: Army? So he targeted wartime documents? Like atomic bomb related papers?
lines.style: Sharp inference, voice rising with curiosity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 鋭いな。実は原爆投下に関する未公開資料を狙っていたらしい。動機は内部告発、つまり政府の隠蔽を暴露するためだと供述している。
lines.en: Sharp guess. He targeted unreleased atomic bomb files. He claims he wanted to expose a government cover-up.
lines.style: Impressed but professional, sharing more detail now.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 暴露が目的だったんですね。あと、彼の交際相手も関与しているって噂は本当ですか?
lines.en: So exposure was the goal. And is the rumor about his partner being involved true?
lines.style: Follow-up question, leaning into the scoop.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: それは捜査中だから書かないでくれ。ちなみに彼、敷地内で煙草を吸って軽犯罪の罰金も食らってる。
lines.en: That's still under investigation, don't print it. By the way, he was fined for smoking on the premises.
lines.style: Off-record warning followed by a wry aside.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 煙草の罰金まで…ちょっと間抜けですね。記事、ちゃんと事実だけ書きます!
lines.en: Fined even for cigarettes... a bit silly. I'll stick strictly to the facts in my article!
lines.style: Amused but reassuring, professional commitment to truth.
